expectations.name: no_trip_ever
expectations.detail: dut:K4_open never observed before the boundary [blocked_on annotation is STALE: this expectation now passes -- the DUT appears to have gained the capability the annotation assumed it lacked; consider removing blocked_on from the scenario]

blocked_on.reason: This forbid clause is currently satisfied for the wrong reason: K4 starts de-energized (open) at boot and stays that way -- relay_owner_command_energize() is fully built (firmware/SaftyFW/src/tasks/relay_owner.c) but called by nothing in the current source tree -- so K4_open is already true at sim-time 0. Separately, this scenario's own exercised guards S1/S10 also cannot evaluate at all today (S1: abs_max_temp_c uncommissioned, Phase 9; S10: context_valid never populated, Phase 7), so 'no trip ever' is not exercising the anti-nuisance behavior it names either way.
blocked_on.phase: For K4 energize: link_task exists but has no LINK_FRAME_REQUEST_ENABLE_CMD case (SAFETY_CMD_REQUEST_ENABLE 0x02, already sent by KilnFW) -- a genuinely missing decoder, Phase 7 work not yet done. For S10's context_valid: link_task already publishes context (link_task_get_context_snapshot()); safety_core_build_input() just never reads it -- a wiring gap, not a Phase 7 existence gap. For S1's abs_max_temp_c: config_store now exists (Phase 9, config_store.{c,h}/ config_store_flash.c) but has no abs_max_temp_c field yet (only tc_type is wired), and safety_core.c never reads config_store for guard thresholds at all -- s_guard_cfg is a zero-initialized static, never populated from flash.
